steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each commission is recomputed from the plan rule and matched to the paid amount.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 commission differs from the recomputed value

findings.title: Commission differs from the recomputed value
findings.fix: Correct the payment to the plan rule

findings.title: Rule cited that is not in the plan

outcome.notChecked: Whether the plan rule is lawful or fair; the payment itself.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a calculation that differs from the recomputed value, a rule cited that is not in the plan, and a booking counted twice.
cons: Not checked: Whether the plan rule is lawful or fair; the payment itself.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-commission-check skill on the records for this review.
